claims.statement: In partner r20's grouped 2+1 exact-rank-three state with delta=det H>1/6, if every normalized original-coordinate leverage u_i^T H^{-1}u_i is <=1/2, Theorem F gives ||p_Q||_infinity <12*6^(1/3)<21.806.

If the >1/2 normalized-leverage rows have Gram minimum eigenvalue at least 1/16, there are at most five such rows and their actual physical principal block has three eigenvalues of modulus >1/96, yielding ||p_Q||_infinity<1864 by the bounded-dimensional theorem.

In account03/B19 r21 R1, after removing the rank-one cross singular span, the block-diagonal self matrix has operator norm >589/590. Hence on one side either the cross-to-orthogonal self slope or the orthogonal self compression has norm >589/1180.

In account03/B19 r21 R3, if the retained anchored packet places probability at least rho on one fixed nonanchor row pair or column pair, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=3 sqrt(e)(rho Z_A)^(-1/6). At rho=1/4 and Z_A>=2^-36/12 this is <604.
